scientific_integrity: Same-model analytical proof and finite enumeration are separate forms of evidence. No independent audit or independent verification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only exact, consistent, unrelaxed, equally spaced planar rows. Claims concern zero-operator termination and optimal one-sweep ordering; not noisy, finite-precision, perturbed-row or higher-dimensional cases. Matching-adjacency enumeration is a standard combinatorial technique, not a claimed new general counting principle. Specialized unindexed equivalent results are possible.
title: Exact finite-termination probabilities and optimal row orders for planar Kaczmarz regular frames
